name: What types of kitchen cabinet damage can be repaired?

mainEntity.name: What types of kitchen cabinet damage can be repaired?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen cabinet repair addresses various issues including chipped laminate, scratched wood, loose hinges, damaged drawers, and structural problems. Common repairs involve patching, sanding, repainting or restaining, hardware replacement, and reinforcing frames. Minor surface imperfections can often be fixed without full replacement, restoring both aesthetics and functionality. For significant water damage or structural integrity issues, a professional assessment is crucial to determine if repair or replacement is the best course of action.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repairs can fix chipped laminate, scratched wood, loose hinges, and damaged drawers. Professionals assess if repair or replacement is needed for significant damage.
